name: Zabbix
description: Bounded Zabbix 7.4 JSON-RPC monitoring, exact history/trends, explicit event acknowledgement and maintenance.

permissions.description: One caller-configured Zabbix 7.4 endpoint; bearer API token. Selected confirmed operations modify host status/display, host groups, problem acknowledgements/severity/suppression/closure and maintenance. No local files, listeners, scripts, login or token management. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Zabbix problem or recovery observed. Reads /api_jsonrpc.php. First successful poll baselines the current finite snapshot. Later polls emit created/updated minimized resources; absent resources never emit deletion. Short-lived intermediate states and resources removed between polls can be missed. Each poll makes one HTTPS read, uses the explicitly bounded newest window, caps the response at 2 MiB and the checkpoint at 110,000 bytes. Narrow scope rather than silently dropping events. Name-filter changes reset the baseline. Checkpoints commit before downstream completion. Downstream failure does not restore them. Resource reappearance after absence emits created; no exactly-once guarantee. This is intentionally only the newest finite event/action window; continuation pages are not read. Events which age out between polls are missed. Existing window contents are baselined, and reappearance may repeat an older item.
